answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 6 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in juniper, checked in garden, and ledge shows each void. A farm of 2089 identities would post 4143 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
